Meet Sip&PopAbout the studio

Our first game

Sip. Match. Pop.

Sip&Pop is a cozy match-3 puzzle set behind the counter of a colorful pixel café. Match drinks, break the ice, create powerful specials, and master each order before the moves run out.

Mix clever combosLine clearers and color bombs turn a good move into a great one.
Follow the café trailUnlock levels, earn stars, and watch your map grow.
Daily ordersReturn for fresh challenges and useful life rewards.
Made to feel aliveCharacterful sound, responsive feedback, and a warm pixel world.

Currently in internal testing on Android
